title: kith-peer: exponential backoff with jitter
description:
What: Enhance OutboxStore.record_failure (in kith-store) to add ±20% random jitter to the next_attempt_at timestamp, and increase max_attempts to 72 (covering ~24h of hourly retries), matching the KITH-8my epic specification.

Algorithm:
1. Read current record_failure in crates/kith-store/src/outbox.rs
2. Change max failure threshold from 9 (10th call) to 71 (72nd call)
3. Change initial delay from 60s to 30s: let base_delay = 30i64 * (1i64 << shift.min(30)); capped at 3600
4. Add jitter: let jitter_range = base_delay / 5; // 20% of delay; let jitter = thread_rng().gen_range(-(jitter_range)..(jitter_range)); let delay_secs = (base_delay + jitter).max(1);
5. Add rand to kith-store Cargo.toml (workspace dep)
6. Ensure thread_rng() is only called in record_failure (not in tests for determinism); tests may use known attempt counts to verify bounds
7. Run: cargo test -p kith-store
8. Run: cargo clippy --all-features -- -D warnings

Defensive rules:
- Jitter must not produce negative delay: clamp to min 1 second
- No overflow: shift is already clamped to 30 bits; base_delay fits in i64
- rand dep must use workspace version; do NOT add getrandom or similar separately
- max_attempts change is behavioral: existing test vectors must be updated to match new thresholds; do NOT delete tests, update their expected values
- If existing test for 10th failure exists, update to verify 72nd failure marks_failed instead

Agent team: Researcher R reads outbox.rs record_failure and existing tests. Implementer I changes max_attempts and adds jitter. Tester T verifies: attempt 71 still retries (does not mark_failed), attempt 72 calls mark_failed; jitter is within ±20% of base delay for sample attempt counts. Validator V runs cargo test -p kith-store + clippy.

Tests (oracle = KITH-8my epic spec: 30s base, 2x doubling, 1h cap, ±20% jitter, 72 max):
- Attempt 0: next_attempt_at in range [now + 24, now + 36] (30s ± 20%)
- Attempt 1: next_attempt_at in range [now + 48, now + 72] (60s ± 20%)
- Attempt 10: next_attempt_at in range [now + 2880, now + 4320] (30*2^10=30720, capped at 3600, ±20% = [2880, 4320])
- Attempt 71: record_failure returns Ok(()); outbox row updated; message NOT marked failed
- Attempt 72: record_failure internally calls mark_failed; message.delivery_state = Failed
